name: Reijou Club ~Dajoku no Ryoshuu-tachi~
original_name: 隷嬢倶楽部～堕辱の虜囚達～
source:
Main character knows weaknesses of his former girlfriend, so decides to turn her into a hostess in an illegal secret club specializing in humiliation and defiling. This way she can never betray him, and he can still love her even in fallen state.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公掌握前女友的弱点，于是决定让她成为一家非法秘密俱乐部的陪酒女。那家俱乐部专门羞辱和玷污女性。这样一来，她便永远无法背叛他，而即使她已经堕落，他也仍能继续爱她。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
